sections.Profile:
"Touchdown" is a football-themed pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1984. Designed by John Trudeau, it features a solid-state setup with two flippers and no ramps or multiball, reflecting its era's straightforward gameplay. With 711 units produced, the game is part of the Gottlieb System 80A series and has a digital display.
